concerns.text: US-001 Scenario 3 requires a statistical significance test (p < 0.05) comparing mean divergence of INT8/INT4/FP8 vs FP16, but no task performs this test. T016 only 'append[s] summary log entry recording the actual observed proportion of non-zero calculated_kl_divergence samples' — a proportion log, not the required significance comparison. An implementer cannot satisfy this acceptance scenario from the current task list.

No task produces a metrics.json conforming to the metrics contract (requires correlation_results per level with bound_consistency, statistical_tests with bonferroni_corrected_p, latency_reduction in ms, and collinearity_check). T022A writes test_metrics.json, T027B writes final_consistency_summary.json, T030 writes latency_metrics.json (in seconds), T018/T019d log VIF to pipeline.log — none produce the contract-shaped artifact, and T024's contract test has no producer to validate. Add a task that assembles/writes the schema-conformant metrics.json.

concerns.location: spec.md:Edge Cases (near-zero gradient norms) vs tasks.md
concerns.text: Spec edge case 2 — 'inputs where gradient norms are near-zero (flat loss landscape): the predictor must not hallucinate a high divergence gap' — has no covering task. T010 covers edge case 1 (zero-divergence KL) and T013 covers edge case 3 (engine load failure), but no unit test or validation task exercises near-zero-gradient inputs against the trained predictor.

Plan task T029 'Implement Full Hardware Sync Baseline (NEW - FR-006, Principle VI)' has no dedicated task; T027's 'dual execution of both policies' partially covers it, but the plan's Constitution Check explicitly cites T029 as the Principle VI evidence. Either add an explicit hardware-sync baseline task or update the plan's task list to point at the covering task (T026/T027) so the Principle VI gate has a traceable matcher.

The spec's threshold-justification assumption mandates 'a sensitivity analysis... sweeping epsilon over a range of small values' for the |predicted - actual| < 0.1 bound, but no task performs this epsilon sweep (T027B verifies only the fixed 0.1 threshold). Add a task or extend T027B to cover the sweep.
